tools.name: find_item
tools.description: Find the name of any physical object, part or daily-life item from a vague Korean (or English) description — shape, place, symptom, field slang (e.g. '싱크대 선반 받치는 손톱만 한 거', '창문 뻑뻑', '문을 바닥에서 잡아 주는 것'). Returns the correct item name, other names, what to measure before buying, a page on 만물도감, and shop
